summary: Asus ROG Zephyrus M16 (2022) with Intel Core i7-12700H CPU, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 GPU, and ASUS PRIME Z690-A motherboard
intent: Troubleshoot and repair Asus ROG Zephyrus M16 system failure mode characterized by overheating issues, thermal throttling, and inability to turn on the system
detected_fault: Overheating issues due to a malfunctioning cooling system or excessive heat generated by the GPU
suggested_solution: Power Cycle: Unplug power cord, wait 30 seconds, and plug back in
Thermal Monitoring: Use software tools like HWiNFO or GPU-Z to monitor temperature
BIOS Updates: Check for BIOS updates and apply them if available
Driver Updates: Update graphics drivers to the latest version
Hardware Inspection: Inspect system's hardware for signs of physical damage or wear
Diagnostic Tests: Run MemTest86+ or Prime95 to identify potential issues with memory or CPU
